items.label: Current office
items.text: Member of the U.S. House of Representatives for California's 41st Congressional District under the pre-2026 map; won the 2024 general election there 51.7% to 48.3%, then ran in the redrawn 40th District in 2026. (sources: Ballotpedia News https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/06/03/incumbent-linda-sanchez-d-and-mitch-clemmons-r-advanced-from-the-top-two-primary-in-californias-41st-congressional-district-on-june-2-2026/ [search summary, secondary])
